meta.lb_info:
This file contains the upper bounds (UB) and lower bounds (LB) for the 60-job problems contained in j60.sm.tgz.

The lower bounds were calculated with the methods given in:

Brucker, P. and Knust, S. (1998): A Linear Programming and Constraint Propagation-Based Lower Bound for the RCPSP, Osnabruecker Schriften zur Mathematik Reihe P, Heft 204.

Heilmann, R. and Schwindt, C. (1997): Lower Bounds for RCPSP/max, Report WIOR-511, Universitaet Karlsruhe.

Klein, R. and Scholl, A. (1997): Computing lower bounds by destructive improvement - an application to resource-constrained project scheduling, Schriften zur Quant. BWL, TH Darmstadt, to appear in EJOR.

If all three methods provide the same result, no author is given.

The upper bounds are as given in the file j60hrs.sm.

Instances where LB = UB holds (i.e., where the optimal makespan has been verified as LB = UB) are marked with an "*".
